scope: Read-only current pinned SDK/config constraints and closed wifi-control-03 allocation failure evidence. No source/config changes, build, or hardware.

observed.conclusion: Actual esp_wifi_init SDK call returned ESP_ERR_NO_MEM (0x101); completionKnown1/timeouts0 distinguishes a returned allocation error from a guard timeout. Exact failed allocation is not recorded.

target_inventory.target_net_saving: Pending new actual ELF; pointer fields/padding mean nominal payload total is not exact net BSS reduction.

internal_requirements.static_hardware_rx_buffers: 8 * approximately1600 DMA bytes, ~12800; estimate from SDK documentation, excludes metadata/alignments.
internal_requirements.dynamic_hardware_tx_buffers: Up to16 dynamic DMA buffers, size depends on frames; no static16 TX pool in this current configuration.
internal_requirements.additional: SDK WiFi task/TCB, WiFi queue and metadata, mutexes, netif/event/tcpip objects, management buffers, transient calibration/NVS/runtime allocations. No total exact startup/peak bound follows from available public source or current MEM snapshots.
internal_requirements.task_api: Ordinary xTaskCreate and FreeRTOS heap require internal8. External-stack-allowed flag alone does not move a task.
internal_requirements.PSRAM_option: TRY_ALLOCATE_WIFI_LWIP remains off. Turning it on here forces static TX by Kconfig and is not a placement-only change; no such tuning was proposed or performed.

pool_migration_assessment.cpu_only_path: Transport payload copy/CRC/parse/preview executes in tasks; BLE notification admission and WiFiSubmit each deep-copy to their separate persistent slots before returning. No transport slot address is submitted to DMA or an ISR.
required_contract: Keep7 slots and all2304 wire bytes plus privateNUL per slot.
Keep metadata, generation, owner flags, mux and FreeRTOS queue descriptors internal.
One permanent allocation with explicit SPIRAM|8BIT; no internalfallback/hot allocation/rebind/free.
Idempotent same-binding init must not clear live pending/owned/retry/WRITING storage; reject different binding.
Before allocation succeeds, no slot.data NULL dereference and publish failures remain explicit.
PSRAM failure must not remove independently allocated command readers/terminal query capability.
Preserve generation checks, all immutable identities, completion/expiry accounting, existing retry TTL, SHORT/full wire bytes and actual DMA owners.
Verify new target map and actual MEM/READY/AP/HWM; extra16KB is not assumed sufficient before HIL.

already_external: AsyncLog workspace and frameSlots via PSRAM-preferred storage
not_move_as_whole: TinyUSB _cdcd_itf/_cdcd_epbuf: SDK/ISR/FIFO/DMA ownership needs dedicated audit
FreeRTOS static event/protocol queues: preserve internal kernel ownership; possible future pointer-payload refactor is broader than this fix
s_appContext/s_fdcWorkers: mixed control/measurement/worker-lifetime objects, not pure text
Small priority/control buffers: preserve available command path
other_objects.deferred: No additional migration selected without evidence that the focused transport payload change is insufficient.

gate: Transport payload move is a justified narrow candidate; wait frozen source lifetime review, target actual savings and AP HIL before claiming restored WiFi.
